cards.meaning: witness — one who saw or knows of an event and testifies to it; 'saksi ng estado' = state witness
cards.example: Binigyan ng Ombudsman ng kondisyonal na imyunidad si Guevarra para maging saksi ng estado.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Ombudsman gave Guevarra conditional immunity to become a state witness.
cards.note: Katutubo at pang-araw-araw; 'testigo' (Espanyol) mas pormal/makaluma, pang-abogado. Pandiwa: sumaksi, naging saksi. 'Saksi ng estado' = dating kasabwat na nagpapatotoo kapalit ng imyunidad.
cards.tiesTo: Samchan's Felicito Guevarra turns state witness in Romualdez plunder case

cards.meaning: expenditure, outlay — money (or time/effort) to be spent on a purpose; root: gugol
cards.example: Sisimulan ng Senado ang pagtalakay sa mga gugulin ng pamahalaan para sa 2027.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Senate begins deliberating the government's expenditures for 2027.
cards.note: Pormal, pang-badyet (Kongreso, ulat ng pamahalaan). Iba sa 'gastos' (pang-araw-araw). Pandiwa: gumugol (gumugol ng panahon) — hindi lang pera, pati panahon at lakas.
cards.tiesTo: Senate opens plenary debate on the 2027 budget

cards.meaning: either… or (a forced choice between two options)
cards.example: 央行要么降息，要么继续等待，没有第三条路。
cards.examplePinyin: Yāngháng yàome jiàngxī, yàome jìxù děngdài, méiyǒu dì-sān tiáo lù.
cards.exampleMeaning: The central bank either cuts rates or keeps waiting; there is no third way.
cards.note: Connective with an edge: only these two options. vs 或者 (neutral alternatives in a statement) and 还是 (in questions: 茶还是咖啡?). Leans 口语/editorial; formal 或者…或者 loses the ultimatum tone.
cards.tiesTo: PBOC holds LPR for an 18th month despite deflation

cards.meaning: to maintain; keep at the current level (often against pressure)
cards.example: 央行连续第18个月维持贷款市场报价利率不变。
cards.examplePinyin: Yāngháng liánxù dì 18 gè yuè wéichí dàikuǎn shìchǎng bàojià lìlǜ búbiàn.
cards.exampleMeaning: The central bank kept the loan prime rate unchanged for an 18th straight month.
cards.note: 书面语/formal; the finance-news verb for holding rates. Collocates: 维持不变, 维持现状, 维持稳定, 维持生活. vs 保持 (broader, neutral: 保持联系, 保持冷静); 维持 = holding something up that might slip (order, a ceasefire, a peg).
